<details>
<summary>Prepare & plot data for analysis</summary>
```{r}

# --- PREPARE DATA FOR ANALYSIS --- #

# Add baselines

baseline = ds_ecosystems %>%
  filter(time_point == time_point_of_baselines) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         all_of(response_variable_selected)) %>%
  rename(baseline = all_of(response_variable_selected))

data_for_analysis = ds_ecosystems %>%
  left_join(baseline)

# Filter and mutate

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>%
  filter(time_point %in% time_points_model,
         !is.na(!!sym(response_variable_selected))) %>%
  mutate(trophic_type = as.factor(trophic_type),
         size = as.factor(ecosystem_size_ml),
         conn = factor(x = ifelse(connection == "connected", 
                                  "con", 
                                  "unconnected"),
                       levels = c("unconnected", "con")),
         volume_disturbed_across_sizes = as.factor(volume_disturbed_across_sizes),
         day = as.double(day),
         ecosystem_ID = as.factor(ecosystem_ID))
```

```{r fig.height = figures_height_rmd_output, fig.width = figures_width_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT ONE PLOT PER ECOSYSTEM SIZE --- #

print("Heterotrophic ecosystems")
plot.ecos.sizes.one.by.one.means(data_for_analysis,
                                 "heterotrophic",
                                 response_variable_selected,
                                 light_colour_hetero,
                                 dark_colour_hetero,
                                 y_upper_limit_selected)
```
</details>

<details>
<summary>Create model</summary>
```{r}

# --- CREATE MODEL --- #

# Prepare data

data_for_analysis = data_for_analysis %>% 
  rename(disturb_type = volume_disturbed_across_sizes) %>%
  filter(trophic_type == "heterotrophic") %>%
  mutate(day = as.factor(day))

# Create formula

formula = as.formula(paste("get(response_variable_selected) ~",
                           "conn * size * disturb_type +",
                           "(1 | baseline) +",
                           "(1 | day)")) %>%
  print()

# Create model

model = glmmTMB(formula,
                data = data_for_analysis,
                dispformula = ~ size + conn + disturb_type + day, # Overdispersion
                ziformula = ~ size + conn + disturb_type, # Zero inflation
                control=glmmTMBControl(optimizer=optim,
                                       optArgs=list(method="BFGS")))
```

```{r}

# --- SHOW MODEL SUMMARY --- #

print(summary(model), digits = 3)
```

```{r}

# --- CODE MODEL CONSTRASTS --- #

# Estimate marginal means (least-squares means)

emmeans_output = emmeans(model,
                         specs = ~  conn * disturb_type * size,
                         adjust = "sidak",
                         bias.adj = TRUE,
                         lmer.df = "satterthwaite") 

emmeans_output

# Give a name for each level which you want to compare

uncon_fixed_6_43 = c(1, rep(0,15)) 
con_fixed_6_43 = c(rep(0,1), 1, rep(0,14)) 
uncon_relative_6_43 = c(rep(0,2), 1, rep(0,13)) 
con_relative_6_43 = c(rep(0,3), 1, rep(0,12)) 
uncon_fixed_9 = c(rep(0,4), 1, rep(0,11)) 
con_fixed_9 = c(rep(0,5), 1, rep(0,10)) 
uncon_relative_9 = c(rep(0,6), 1, rep(0,9)) 
con_relative_9 = c(rep(0,7), 1, rep(0,8)) 
uncon_fixed_15 = c(rep(0,8), 1, rep(0,7))
con_fixed_15 = c(rep(0,9), 1, rep(0,6))
uncon_relative_15 = c(rep(0,10), 1, rep(0,5))
con_relative_15 = c(rep(0,11), 1, rep(0,4))
uncon_fixed_45 = c(rep(0,12), 1, rep(0,3))
con_fixed_45 = c(rep(0,13), 1, rep(0,2))
uncon_relative_45 = c(rep(0,14), 1, rep(0,1))
con_relative_45 = c(rep(0,15), 1)

# Compute the contrasts

n_of_digits = 3
contrasts = contrast(emmeans_output, 
                     method = list("6.43 ml fixed" = con_fixed_6_43 - uncon_fixed_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_9 - uncon_fixed_9,
                                   "15.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_15 - uncon_fixed_15,
                                   "45.00 ml fixed" = con_fixed_45 - uncon_fixed_45,
                                   "6.43 ml relative" = con_relative_6_43 - uncon_relative_6_43,
                                   "9.00 ml relative" = con_relative_9 - uncon_relative_9,
                                   "15.00 ml relative" = con_relative_15 - uncon_relative_15,
                                   "45.00 ml relative" = con_relative_45 - uncon_relative_45)) 

nested_contrasts <- contrast(contrasts, 
                             method = list(
                               "Difference in effects at 6.43 ml" = c(1, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0, 0),
                               "Difference in effects at 9.00 ml" = c(0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 0),
                               "Difference in effects at 15.00 ml" = c(0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0),
                               "Difference in effects at 45.00 ml" = c(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1)
                             ))

# Tidy up the contrasts & Sidak correct

contrasts = contrasts %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)

nested_contrasts = nested_contrasts %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = n_of_digits),
         estimate = round(estimate, digits = n_of_digits),
         SE = round(SE, digits = n_of_digits),
         df = round(df, digits = n_of_digits),
         t.ratio = round(t.ratio, digits = n_of_digits),
         e = "",
         e = ifelse(p.value > 0.1, 
                           "",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.05, 
                           "*",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.01, 
                           "**",
                           e),
         e = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, 
                           "***",
                           e)) %>%
  rename(" " = e)
```

<details open = "open">
<summary>Model residuals</summary>
```{r fig.width = figures_height_rmd_output}

# --- PLOT MODEL RESIDUALS --- #

# Simulate residuals from the fitted model

simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, 
                                      n = 1000) 

# Test for overdispersion in the model to check if variance exceeds mean

testDispersion(simulationOutput)

# Plot Q-Q and Residuals vs Fitted plots

plot(simulationOutput)

# Plot residuals against specific predictors to check if residuals are 
# independent of these variables

plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$day) 
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$size)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$conn)
plotResiduals(simulationOutput, 
              form = data_for_analysis$disturb_type)

# Test for outliers 

testOutliers(simulationOutput)

# Test for zero inflation not accounted for. From the vignette:
# "This test is likely better suited for detecting zero-inflation than the 
# standard plot, but note that also overdispersion will lead to excess zeros, 
# so only seeing too many zeros is not a reliable diagnostics for moving towards 
# a zero-inflated model. A reliable differentiation between overdispersion and 
# zero-inflation will usually only be possible when directly comparing 
# alternative models, e.g. through residual comparison / model selection of a 
# model with / without zero-inflation, or by simply fitting a model with 
# zero-inflation and looking at the parameter estimate for the zero-inflation. 
# A good option is the R package glmmTMB, which is also supported by DHARMa."

testZeroInflation(simulationOutput)
```
